items.name: v43.10 update
items.notes: Epic has confirmed a v43.10 update for Thursday 12 November (Epic's Ted Timmins called it "Thursday's update") but hasn't posted a downtime time. Outlets expect about 09:00–10:30 UTC (4–5:30 AM ET), based on earlier mid-season updates. Converted to SAST. Times will be corrected once @FortniteStatus posts them.

items.name: Treasure Hunters mini-season
items.notes: Ended Chapter 7 Season 4 "Override" and launched the Treasure Hunters mini-season on the new Crossbones Isle map, plus a new Ranked season. Epic scheduled downtime for 1 AM ET (05:00 UTC); its status page marked it complete at 08:12 UTC (10:12 SAST).

items.name: Epic Online Services maintenance (Sessions & Lobbies)
items.notes: Back-end maintenance window of up to 90 minutes (06:00–07:30 UTC). Parties, lobbies and matchmaking may be affected. Not a Fortnite download. No source has confirmed the actual end time.

items.name: Chapter 7 Season 4 "Override"
items.notes: Start time confirmed by @FortniteStatus; return time as reported by press coverage.
